purpose: Test a broad cross-WM selective-intervention policy on the declared IDP mechanism family after exact static and dynamic threshold lanes qualified.

evidence.PASSIVE: z-normalized learned-WM residual at the matched first command u1
evidence.FULL: PASSIVE + independent cart reference + centered residual control-slope contrast

policy.family_selector: fixed RandomForest trained on PASSIVE to choose STATIC, DYNAMIC, or NONPURE/FULL
policy.semantic_classifier: fixed RandomForest 7-state classifier per evidence stage
policy.partial_commit_rule: commit only a pure predicted state when its top probability exceeds the source-wise calibrated threshold; otherwise acquire FULL
policy.passive_nonpure_rule: PASSIVE never escalates or commits; NONPURE family suspicion acquires FULL
policy.full_rule: commit only certified pure; otherwise SAFE_ABSTAIN_OR_ESCALATE
policy.calibration: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson source-wise and pooled risk constraints
policy.nonfinal_no_safe_threshold: disable the partial stage and fall through to FULL

baselines.RANDOM_FIRST_PROBE: deterministically choose STATIC or DYNAMIC with equal probability; same semantic classifiers/thresholds; fall through to FULL
baselines.FULL_EVIDENCE: always acquire FULL; reporting upper-bound comparator only

decision_rule.BROAD_DEV_PRIMARY_EFFICIENCY_PASS: primary >=6/8 + median pass and efficiency >=6/8 + median ratio <=0.85
decision_rule.BROAD_DEV_PRIMARY_PASS_EFFICIENCY_FAIL: primary qualifies but efficiency does not

after_primary_efficiency_pass: May freeze the final fresh IDP hidden evaluation using the already-committed hidden seeds. Hidden is still not authorized by this config.
after_failure: Stop and preserve the broad development failure; do not tune this version in place.
